svg.aria-label: tock: a day fills itself in on a timeline as a brass hand sweeps from 08:30 to 14:02, coloured by kind of time: deep work in teal, shallow in slate blue, a distraction in rust, time away as dots. The focus score counts up to 86, a good day. An unlabelled block is then labelled Research with one key.
svg.title: tock: where your working day went, filled in automatically, with a focus score and one-key labelling.
svg.text: trackd writes down what is in front, all day. Your rules label it.
